description:
"Channel the abyssal sea to coalesce a beam that heals you and your allies in its path for |cffffff36764|r Health over |cffffff4.5|r seconds.

The beam heals for up to |cffffff50|r% more in proportion to the severity of the target's wounds as you reweave fate itself.

Consume Crux to also restore |cffffff728|r Magicka and Stamina per Crux spent to your allies over |cffffff4.5|r seconds."
